entities.name: Charix
entities.description: Charix, the Raging Isle, a continent-sized leviathan crab born from the ruins of the Tazeem Skyclave on Zendikar.

entities.name: Tazeem Skyclave
entities.description: Kor skyclave ruin destroyed by Iona; its pieces fell into the ocean.

entities.name: Skyclaves
entities.description: Kor structures that rose once more.

events.summary: Iona destroys the Tazeem Skyclave; a ruin housing a kor artifact lands on crab eggs, crushing all but one.
events.quote: The eggs were all crushed, except for one.

events.summary: The surviving crab gorges on the artifact's energy and grows enormous, feeding on further artifacts.
events.quote: the crab, denied normal food, gorged itself on the energy of the artifact

events.summary: When the Skyclaves rise again, Charix's food supply is interrupted and he breaches from the depths seeking sustenance.
events.quote: Charix has breached from the depths in search of sustenance

relations.quote: When Iona destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave
